assessment.body:
## Verdict

agent_supports: yes
daemon_capability: full
driver_capability: ready

## Reasoning

OpenCode 2.x queues a prompt sent while a turn runs: `POST …/prompt` with `delivery: "queue"` (2.1.4 openapi Session.Inbox.Delivery: steer, queue). Probed on the sandbox service (/Users/factory/.oc2sb/qa/p5b2-work/probe/2-10-queue.log): the queued prompt waited in the session inbox (`GET …/inbox` listed it) while turn 1 streamed; when turn 1's step finished, the service wrote the queued user row and the agent answered it in the SAME execution — one idle row at the very end, no idle between the two answers, and no `synthetic` row.

## What the daemon has to do

One contiguous working span: no ready when turn 1's step finishes (no idle row lands there), no flicker when the queued user row lands, and ready once everything is consumed (the single idle row / Stop hook).
caveats: The probe showed no synthetic row on this path, so #2127's finding 2 (no parser branch for `synthetic`) is not in play; the recording checks it again.

sources.note: each assistant row's model.id is the step's ModelName; text items feed applyAssistantText (task-estimate scan)

2.x reader: lists session_v2 rows with time_archived IS NULL; a session is admitted on its first session_message activity while a service is up (#2107); an archived or missing row emits EventRemoved (v2SessionGone)
2.x hook receiver: permission.asked holds waiting, session.execution.{succeeded,failed,interrupted} end the turn through HandleStopHook (#2108)
probe: a queued prompt joined the running execution; one idle row at the end

preconditions: One OpenCode 2.x `serve --service` running, with a model it can reach (this host: the sandbox service, local Kolibri-1 4-bit model (mlx_lm) at 127.0.0.1:8087); the rig never starts, stops or reconfigures it
The three XDG exports, coexist IRRLICHT_ONBOARD_HOME and a non-7837 bind address from replaydata/agents/opencode-v2/prerequisites.md; OPENCODE_DB unset
setup: driver-interactive.sh (API driver) refuses before creating anything unless exactly one `serve --service` runs, its environment carries the run's XDG_* values, and the plugin's beacon resolves this run's daemon

It creates one session over POST /api/session at <staging>/cwd, waits for the service log to show the plugin the daemon installed loading for that location with no load failure, then drives the script; the session's session_message rows are exported read-only as the transcript
settings deny the shell tool in RUN_CWD/opencode.json (a backstop: the local model reached for it in a no-tool turn once)
a slow first prompt; 5s later, while it runs, a second prompt with delivery queue (the driver refuses unless the store shows the turn still in flight)

script.text: Write a 400-word explanation of how TCP works, covering the three-way handshake, sequence numbers, acknowledgements, and flow control. Use full paragraphs. Do not use any tools.
Now also list three fun facts about giraffes. Do not use any tools.

verify: working from the first prompt, with no ready or waiting for at least 12s — through the queued prompt's arrival
both prompts answered (two user rows in the transcript)
